githubPackageExceptions.justification: Pinned AWS SDK transitive dependency distributed unmodified with its upstream LICENSE retained. GitHub recognizes the MITNFA no-false-attribution clause in addition to MIT, although npm metadata reports MIT. That clause requires substantially modified distributions to replace or remove upstream bug-report contacts; no such modifications are made. Reviewed the shipped 2.14.1 LICENSE and https://github.com/bowser-js/bowser/blob/v2.14.1/LICENSE. This exception applies only to that version; vulnerability review remains enabled.
